need_own_app.answer: Not for a prototype, since Composio manages a Slack app. For production, Composio's docs suggest your own credentials, because users see the consent screen and the managed app shows Composio's name.

prerequisites.title: Slack app with client ID and secret
prerequisites.detail: Create the app in app settings; the client ID is on the App Management page and token exchange needs the client secret.

prerequisites.title: HTTPS redirect URL
prerequisites.detail: The redirect URL must use HTTPS and cannot contain an anchor. Copy Composio's redirect URI from the Composio dashboard.

steps.title: Create Slack app in app settings
steps.detail: Sign in and create the app at api.slack.com/apps.
steps.done_when: App exists with client ID and secret available.

steps.title: Choose bot and user scopes
steps.detail: Draft the scope list: bot scopes via scope, user scopes via user_scope. Mark non-essential scopes optional.

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create a custom auth config via Composio's API with your client ID and secret.
steps.done_when: Auth config returns a Composio redirect URI.

steps.title: Add redirect URL to Slack app
steps.detail: Paste the Composio redirect URI under OAuth & Permissions as a Redirect URL.
steps.done_when: Redirect URL is saved in Slack.

steps.title: Prepare Marketplace submission
steps.detail: Draft scope justifications and listing details; show usage of every scope, including optional ones.

steps.title: Submit app for Marketplace review
steps.detail: Submit the app and accept Slack's policies and agreements.

steps.title: Wait for Marketplace review
steps.detail: Slack reviews the app; the duration is unknown.

traps.title: Unapproved scopes block published app installs
traps.detail: A published app fails with unapproved_scope if its scopes are in review or were never submitted.

traps.title: Non-distributed apps install only at home
traps.detail: Installing an undistributed app on another team gives invalid_team_for_non_distributed_app.

traps.title: Redirect URI mismatches
traps.detail: With several Redirect URLs, send the same redirect_uri in both Authorize and Access steps. Otherwise you get bad_redirect_uri.

traps.title: Scope combination errors
traps.detail: Do not mix Sign in with Slack scopes with other scopes in one flow. Non-org-compatible scopes fail in Enterprise orgs.

traps.title: Short-lived authorization code
traps.detail: The temporary code expires after ten minutes, so exchange it promptly.

blockers.symptom: Members cannot install the app; approval is required
blockers.what_it_means: The workspace turned on Require App Approval, so non-pre-approved apps need admin approval.
blockers.what_to_do: Ask the customer's admin to approve the app and choose permitted optional scopes.
blockers.agent_can_help: Draft a request note explaining each scope.

blockers.symptom: Enterprise org upgrade shows an error asking to contact an admin
blockers.what_it_means: Moving to org-level installation may need an Org Owner or Org Admin.
blockers.what_to_do: Have an org owner or admin perform the install.
